gloss: to arrange; to see to; to handle as one thinks best

definitions.gloss: to arrange; to see to; to handle at one's discretion
definitions.explanation: To make arrangements so that a matter goes well, using one's own judgment, often as a favor to someone. Usually with てくれる or ていただく, or in requests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{計|はか}らって⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please handle it as you think best.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{計|はか}らって⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The teacher made special arrangements for us.

examples.japanese: {皆|みんな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちよく→気持ちいい：09583_kimochiii⟧⟦{過|す}ごせる→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{幹事|かんじ}→幹事：16378_kanji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いろいろ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{計|はか}らって⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The organizer saw to all sorts of things so that everyone could have a pleasant time.

notes:
USAGE:
A slightly formal, old-fashioned verb. Today the compound {取|と}り{計|はか}らう is more common: ⟦よろしく→よろしく：01070_yoroshiku⟧お{取|と}り{計|はか}らい⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧ (please make the appropriate arrangements), a set phrase in business letters.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{計|はか}らう: to deal with as one sees fit
- ~よう(⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧){計|はか}らう: to arrange it so that ~
- {計|はか}らって⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to have someone arrange things for one

WATCH OUT:
- ⟦{見計|みはか}らう→見計らう：32282_mihakarau⟧: to judge (the right moment) — {時|とき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見計|みはか}らう→見計らう：32282_mihakarau⟧
- ⟦{計|はか}る→計る：28292_hakaru⟧ / ⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to measure; to plan, to attempt — a different verb, without the う
